action.objective: Commit the verified move Kg1, tucking the king to safety and keeping the rook on h1 active.
action.rationale: Only f1g1 is commit-ready: depth-3 exact score -109 with complete safety check (no mate in one, tactical refutation not_found, checking-chain not_found). It is also the broad-search suggestion and strongest exact evidence. Other candidates (g3e5, h1g1, h2h3) are only upper-bound scores, so their real value can be much worse; no replan gate triggered. Kg1 avoids the b2/d1 battery hitting f1 and preserves h1 rook support. Position remains materially lost, but this is the best verified continuation. No continuation supplied due to residual uncertainty about Black's quiet threats.
